customManagers.description: The screenshot script pins the same Playwright image as the e2e workflow, so the baselines it writes are the ones CI compares against. No built-in manager reads a shell script.

packageRules.description: Every dependency lives in the pnpm catalog, whose entries are neither `dependencies` nor `devDependencies`. The `bump` strategy of mheob/renovate-config does not reach them, so Renovate would only refresh the lockfile; keep raising the ranges as before.

vite-plus bundles Vitest, and `vp migrate` re-pins `vitest` and its lockstep packages to the bundled runner. Bumped on their own they would split Vitest between two copies (https://viteplus.dev/guide/upgrade-project#updating-the-vitest-pin).
vite-plus and the `vite` alias to its core ship together. Their own PR, because it needs `vp migrate` before merging.
prBodyNotes: Run `vp migrate` on this branch and commit the result, so `vitest` and `@vitest/coverage-v8` follow the runner the new release bundles.

packageRules.description: The Playwright image ships the browsers of exactly one Playwright release, so `@playwright/test` has to match its tag. An npm release waits out `minimumReleaseAge`, while mcr.microsoft.com reports no release date and the image would come at once (WEB-444). Open the branch only when all three are ready: the package, the image of the e2e workflow and the image of the screenshot script. A digest-only rebuild of the same tag keeps its browsers and stays in the non-major group.
